summary: First full test run of ApexNode Panel v2 (PHP panel + FastAPI daemon). Wrote pytest suite with 34 tests covering PWA endpoints, auth guard, sidebar nav, servers CRUD/detail, real daemon start/stop bridge (via /servers/action -> http daemon), Mods/loader endpoints, /json/loaders JSON API, Eggs list/detail/deploy form, Theme customizer persistence, /theme.css per-user CSS, Discord bogus-token flash-error path, Backups (manual run -> COMPLETED row), Files index + path-traversal sandbox. All 34 backend tests pass. Playwright UI run also passes: login, dashboard tiles, file manager (create folder, create file, save, reopen with persisted content), egg list + CS2 filter chip, egg detail, /servers/new loader picker refetches on game=cs2 and shows CS2 loader chips, backup completes, Discord test with bogus token surfaces red flash without crash.

issues: Status pill reads 'DISCONNECTED' rather than 'FAILED' after a bogus-token test as the review request phrased it. Functionally correct (red flash 'Set a bot token first.' is shown and page does not crash) — cosmetic label mismatch vs spec.

action_items: (Optional) Make the Discord status pill read 'FAILED' (not 'DISCONNECTED') when a token test fails, to match the review request wording.
critical_code_review_comments: Login form uses field name 'email' (accepts either email or username via SQL OR). Test credentials md correctly documents both forms; no bug, but worth noting that the input placeholder should reflect that.
check_csrf() responds 419 + JSON on failure even for HTML form posts; UX-wise you might want to flash and redirect instead of dumping JSON in a form context. Not a blocker.
Backup runner and daemon are supervisor-managed; ensure production install script wires them into systemd equivalently (install.sh already does).

Theme controller stores mode/radius as strings; radius is stored as '12px' string not integer — fine but validate range/whitelist to avoid CSS injection through user input (currently only accent is regex-validated).
test_credentials: admin / admin123 (login form field name is 'email' but accepts username too)
seed_data_creation: Reused seeded servers (Survival SMP, Bedrock Realm, CS2 5v5 EU, Rust Vanilla, Creative Build) and 9 seeded eggs. Test created a 'plugins' folder + 'note.txt' under /var/lib/apexnode/servers/1/, a backup row for server 1, and set the admin theme accent to #A855F7.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend suite lives at /app/backend/tests/test_apexnode_panel.py and runs via `python -m pytest backend/tests/test_apexnode_panel.py -o addopts='-n 0'` (repo pytest.ini forces -n 2 --dist loadscope; my session-scoped login fixture is safe under loadscope because the whole module runs on one worker, but if you split classes across modules re-authenticate per module). Login POST uses field name 'email' (accepts username value). Daemon action endpoint is POST /servers/action with form fields id + action (NOT /servers/{id}/action). Route table is in /app/panel/public/router.php. /theme.css is per-session — fetch it through the authenticated session, not a bare requests.get.
